name: Nova Tweaks Performance Power Plan
description: Activates a custom power plan to prioritize processor performance and reduce energy-saving interruptions for demanding tasks.

description_i18n.en: Activates a custom power plan to prioritize processor performance and reduce energy-saving interruptions for demanding tasks.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert einen benutzerdefinierten Energieplan, der die Prozessorenleistung priorisiert und energie sparende Unterbrechungen für anspruchsvolle Aufgaben reduziert.
description_i18n.fr: Active un profil d'alimentation personnalisé pour privilégier les performances du processeur et réduire les interruptions de conservation d'énergie.

warnings.title: Increased Power Usage
warnings.message: This plan prioritizes maximum CPU speed over power saving. Your system may consume more electricity and generate higher heat under load compared to standard plans

warnings.title: Higher Temperatures
warnings.message: By keeping processor cores active at high frequencies, the system may run hotter than usual during intensive workloads

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Creates a new power scheme based on the Ultimate Performance profile and configures processor settings including minimum/maximum performance states, energy efficiency preferences, core parking behavior, and boost thresholds
compact_description: Improves responsiveness and boosts consistency for gaming, multitasking, and heavier desktop workloads.
